name: export-oauth-token-cache
summary: Fetch an OAuth client_credentials bearer token, cache it in secrets, auto-refresh on 401.

client_secret.description: secret name in hook secrets (not the value)

token_path.description: JMESPath to the token in the response

notes: Store the secret in hook secrets, never inline. Refresh triggered on 401 from a downstream stage. Hook secrets_schema: OPEN string-map shape (declared client_secret key + additionalProperties {"type": "string"}) — the engine writes the cached token into hook secrets at runtime; a closed additionalProperties: false schema would reject the first refresh (export-pipeline-reference#authentication).
